title: UNIVERSAL Roblox External ALWAYS UPDATED SOURCE
script:
Fully Custom Auto updating Roblox External
feature packed works on all games
Rivals, Phantom Forces, Frontline, Deadline, Counterblox, bloxstrike, Bad Business.

For more info please join the discord linked above or PM me at: vana0x1
features:
AIMBOT
  Aimbot
    - Enabled (keybind: Hold/Toggle)
    - Aim Type (Mouse / Memory / Silent)
    - Hitbox (Head / HumanoidRootPart / Torso / Closest Part)
    - Prediction
      - Prediction X (slider)
      - Prediction Y (slider)
    - Max Distance
      - Distance Limit (slider)
    - Smoothing (slider)

  Rage
    - Target Orbit
    - Target Spam TP
    - Magic Bullet
    - Wall Penetration
      - Proximity Only
        - Max Distance (slider)

  Settings
    - FOV
      - Draw FOV (+, Dotted FOV)
        - FOV Size (slider)
      - Fill FOV (color)
    - Hitsounds
      - HitSound selection (list)
    - Hit Tracers (color)
    - Hit Markers (color)
    - Silent Crosshair
      - Silent Crosshair Tracer (color)

  Triggerbot
    - Enabled (keyboard)
    - Delay (slider)
    - Threshold (slider)
    - Tool Check

VISUALS
  Player ESP
    - Enabled
    - Name (color, outline)
    - Box (color, outline)
    - Health Bar (color)
      - Health Bar Color Type (Static / Health-Based)
    - Skeleton (color, outline)
    - Chams (color, outline)
      - Chams Type (Convex / Concave / Wireframe)
    - Tracers (color, outline, dotted)
      - Origin (Bottom / Top / Center / Mouse)
    - Distance (color, outline)
    - Tool (color, outline)
    - Team

  Visual Settings
    - Use Display Name
    - Local ESP
    - Max Distance
      - Max Distance Value (slider)
    - Font (Default / Visitor / Small Roman Sim / Bold Verdana / Lato Bold/ Minecraftia)
    - Chams Outline Thickness (slider)

WORLD
  Movement / Misc
    - Fly Hack (keyboard)
      - Fly Speed (slider)
    - CFrame Speed (keyboard)
      - CFrame Speed (slider)
    - Freecam (keyboard)
      - Freecam Speed (slider)
    - Third Person (keyboard)
      - Third Person Distance (slider)
    - Force Reset (button)
    - Desync (keyboard)

  Game Specific
    - Time Changer
      - Time (slider)
    - Infinite Jump
      - Custom Jump Power
        - Jump Power (slider)
    - NoClip (keyboard)
    - Spinbot
      - Spinbot Speed (slider)
    - Upside Down
    - Fov Changer
      - Camera FOV (slider)
    - Zoom (keyboard)
      - Zoom Value (slider)

  Waypoints
    - Waypoint List
    - Create / Teleport / Delete Buttons
    - Waypoint Name (input)
    - Name (color)
    - Distance (color)

  Weather
    - Enable Weather
      - Type (None / Snow / Rain / Stars / Rainbow)
      - Particle Count (slider)
      - Occlude Particles

MISC
  Configs
    - Config List
    - Select Config
    - Load / Save / Delete / Create
    - Config Name (input)

  Cheat Settings
    - Keybind List
    - Watermark
     - Rescan (button)

PLAYERS
  - Player List
  - Player Preview (avatar image)
  - Teleport (button)
  - Spectate (button)
  - Unspectate (button)

SETTINGS / CUSTOMIZATION
  Theme
    - Window Color (color)
    - Accent Color (color)
    - Child Color (color)
    - Outline Color (color)
    - Dark Text Color (color)
    - Text Color (color)
    - Unsafe Text Color (color)
    - Inline Color (color)

  General
    - Import / Export Theme

   Keybind List (global)
  - Menu Keybind (INS / F1)
  - Exit (button)

GLOBAL OVERLAYS
  - Watermark overlay
  - Crossfade elements
